spp.plan_summary: Set level1 optimization for the measured C-SDLC v3 test job while retaining debug assertions and overflow checks; disable debug symbols and incremental compilation for that ephemeral lane. Preserve every test, format and Clippy command and required aggregate. Add focused workflow contract and document baseline. Validate locally, independently review, publish and measure hosted result.
spp.acceptance_criteria_inline: All existing Rust test invocations and required gates retained; local contracts pass and hosted exact-head comparison documents wall and runner times without premature speedup claims.
spp.notes_risks_inline: Optimization trades compilation time for reduced repeated installed-binary execution and hashing. Debug symbols omitted from CI diagnostics only; no stable installed binary changes.
spp.validation_plan_inline: Focused Python profile contract and Ruby workflow policy locally; full Rust tests/format/Clippy in hosted CI.
spp.dependencies_inline: ADL1270 opened under cognitive-sdlc205; current main and run38499336594 evidence available.

spp.target_files_surfaces_inline: .github/workflows/ci.yaml; adl/tools CI profile proof; docs/tooling CI performance evidence.

srp.review_scope: CI profile semantics, complete unchanged test inventory and required gates, failure propagation, honest performance evidence.

srp.follow_up_routing: Return actionable findings to ADL1270 implementer.
